Name: Location-Specific Experience Gain Mod
Author: casualcozy
Description:
The purpose of this mod is to negate any skill experience gained when the player is not located inside Clint's shop. You could customize the mod to set the condition to any GameLocation, just replace "Blacksmith" in the code with the specific Location name (which you can find on the wiki). It does not affect the Luck skill experience, only Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining, and Combat. It may be useful for various flavours of books-only challenge runs, which was the inspiration for developing it.

I have tested the mod alongside a skills experience bar mod and they are compatible. I have also tried it on a pre-existing save, and while it was functional, it does not remove pre-existing XP, it only stops the player from gaining experience. It seems to function fine with Mastery but I haven't tested it fully. If you try it and run into issues, please tell me!

The [url=https://github.com/casualcozy/SDVMods/tree/main/LocationSpecificExperienceGain]source code[/url] is available.
